hostObservation.quotaConsumedByNativeQualification: none: no native session opened. The rise between readings (5-hour 46 -> 89 %, weekly 43 -> 49 %) is the account's other concurrent sessions, including this offline work and its reviews, not T008 native units.

limits: Quota readings are integer percentages of plan windows; sub-point consumption is invisible and caps are enforced at one-point granularity. Per-unit token counts are not observed.

The weekly cost of a unit is unknown before it runs. Admission reserves the largest weekly delta seen so far in the cohort, which is zero for the first unit, so a first-unit overshoot of the cohort or 80 % stop is detected at settlement, not prevented.
Freshness bound of 300 s is an implementation choice; the D2 record says only 'stale'.
One HostQualificationRun is one cohort. Unit and cohort caps are not persisted across runs; the trusted caller must not restart a cohort to reset them.

ProfileDecision, D2Caps and QuotaObservation are trusted in-process inputs; the run checks their types and host, not that they came from parse_profile_decisions / parse_d2_caps or a real get_usage reading.
A qualified verdict needs one completed unit within caps and no integrity stop; it says nothing about utility, and never about the other host.
Route is supplied by the caller as 'subscription' when get_usage reports plan status ok; get_usage exposes no route field.
nativeFeasibility: Infeasible now with the existing adapters. harness_host_claude.run_claude refuses any non-double transport unless the manifest names host kind 'claude', but harness_manifest parses only the offline profile; no native ClaudeTransport subclass exists; harness_lab offers only simulated containment; and no Claude HostQualification with enforced credential/filesystem/network/process effects has been issued from evidence. The founder authorization requires containment verified before every native session and the brief allows only the containment the adapters already verify, so a native session would have to bypass the adapters or rely on a self-authored qualification record (synthetic evidence). Neither was done.
outcome: agent_braid/harness_hosts.py: hash-bound parsing of the founder T008 record into independent per-host decisions (Codex not-qualified: not installed; a host without its own decision stays refused) and of the D2 record into exact caps; strict quota observations bound by SHA-256; a serial one-host cohort that, before every unit, requires a fresh, non-regressing reading, refuses on extra usage, non-subscription route, window reset or imminent reset, weekly stop, cohort cap and five-hour headroom, and verifies the Claude containment qualification (reusing harness_host_claude.verify_host_qualification) for environment and expiry through the unit deadline; settlement records deltas, wall time and the first breach and latches a stop. Partial qualification never implies both-host acceptance.
